verdict.rationale: Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Argon model card has a Safety & Security section. It documents human and automated red teaming, pre-release Ethics & Safety Reviews, and testing under the Frontier Safety Framework, and it publishes internal safety evaluation results tables. Missing for 10: details of the Frontier Safety Framework's thresholds or enforcement (the 'teeth'), and independent corroboration of the published safety evaluations.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, the vendor publishes safety evaluations or a responsible-release process for its frontier models — red-teaming, risk assessments, or a safety framework with teeth

citations.quote: Human Red Teaming Results: We conduct manual red teaming by specialist teams...
Ethics & Safety Reviews were conducted ahead of the model's release. In addition, we perform testing following the guidelines in Google DeepMind's Frontier Safety Framework (FSF).
Model Cards are intended to provide essential information on Gemini models, including known limitations, mitigation approaches, and safety performance.
